releaseScope: Concise public product overview: native Rust/GPUI photo, vector and Create workflows with gpui-omarchy themes. The complete manual is docs/user-guide/README.md.
releaseState: Omuse0.12 exact public runtime9c684cae passes final Linux/Windows CI and both package smoke checks. Source/download publication and normal installed upgrade are in progress; Windows setup remains a separate pending qualification. No stable, broad hardware or live-provider claim.

statusDefinitions.label: Implemented in candidate
statusDefinitions.meaning: The source/UI capability exists in the candidate. This label does not establish completed public release or platform qualification.

statusDefinitions.label: Experimental
statusDefinitions.meaning: A bounded workflow is present, but results depend on the source/model/provider and require explicit review or refinement.

statusDefinitions.label: Planned / qualification work
statusDefinitions.meaning: Roadmap or release-qualification work remains; it is not claimed as a delivered or qualified capability.

releaseSnapshot.label: Release state
releaseSnapshot.detail: Final exact-source CI40161067985 passed1,881 Linux and1,838 Windows application cases, zero failures and8 ignored each;20 dependency-helper cases per platform are separate. Public download and setup availability are recorded in docs/release-0120-qualification.md.

releaseSnapshot.label: Public source candidate
releaseSnapshot.detail: Final runtime9c684cae includes guarded file-path Enter and direct clipped-content dragging. Editing/Create/catalog/layout/motion and package gates passed. Omuse0.12 is a pre-release; broader hardware, Windows desktop and image-quality qualification remain bounded.

releaseSnapshot.label: One editor
releaseSnapshot.detail: Shared native Rust/GPUI canvas, layers and reversible review with Omarchy theme integration.

releaseSnapshot.label: Editable master
releaseSnapshot.detail: Complete directory packages preserve supported sources, recipes and page content. New retained features can require document formats 16–19.

releaseSnapshot.label: Local guided masks
releaseSnapshot.detail: Positive marks/box, explicit model acquisition, manual correction and review before keeping. Model weights are not bundled.

releaseSnapshot.label: Full instructions
releaseSnapshot.detail: This is a curated overview. See docs/user-guide/README.md and the linked guides/source/tests for full controls and limits.

categories.name: Photo editing
categories.summary: Paint, select, repair and develop photos while retaining an editable master.

items.name: Raster editing and retouch
items.current: Brush, Pencil, Eraser, Fill, Gradient, Crop, Resize, Clone, Heal, Blur, Smudge and Liquify work on eligible pixel layers with Undo.
items.boundary: Retained photo sources need an appropriate raster copy for ordinary painting. Background retouch has pixel and work limits.

items.name: Selections and colour ranges
items.current: Use geometric, lasso and wand selections, soft coverage, feathering and colour/luminosity ranges to constrain editing.
items.boundary: Selection quality depends on image detail and settings; complex edges may need manual refinement.

items.name: Controlled object removal
items.current: Choose allowed donors and review paired Fit/100% native layer crops. Pan, Center and Refresh stay pinned; changed settings invalidate an older review.
items.boundary: Context can refuse insufficient donors. Texture is experimental; repeated backgrounds and fine edges require visual review. Detail is a layer view.

items.name: Retained Native16 photo development
items.current: Supported Camera Raw stages operate on retained developed-RGB words, with guarded background review, editable recipes, native sampling and Undo.
items.boundary: Up to 16,777,216 pixels plus memory admission. Not sensor-linear RAW, HDR, calibrated profiles, Adobe appearance parity or GPU acceleration.

items.name: Embedded .cube colour looks
items.current: Import supported 1D, 3D and shaper-plus-3D looks into editable stacks with 0–200% Amount; validated tables remain embedded in .omuse.
items.boundary: Encoded-sRGB lookup/output clipping; not an ICC/HDR profile. Input/table/project budgets apply; new looks require document format 17.

items.name: Reviewed XMP preset intent
items.current: Review supported approximations and unsupported preset fields before applying native Camera Raw settings. Accepted mapping provenance stays with the recipe.
items.boundary: Partial intent mapping only. Proprietary profiles, Kelvin/As Shot white balance, crops and local adjustments remain unsupported; no Adobe rendering equivalence.

categories.name: Layers and masks
categories.summary: Combine editable sources, coverage and layout on one canvas.

items.name: Layers, folders and appearance
items.current: Organize image, text and artwork layers with groups, visibility, locks, placement, opacity and supported blend modes.
items.boundary: Pass-through groups and unsupported exchange semantics have documented limits; source rectangles can include transparent padding.

items.name: Editable masks and mask inspection
items.current: Add, paint and inspect soft layer/group masks while retaining source pixels. Guided mask acceptance preserves active earlier coverage.
items.boundary: Mask extent, outside coverage and disabled bitmap state remain distinct. Use the master when an export bakes coverage.

items.name: Layer alpha clipping
items.current: Use supported clipping relationships to limit a layer through another layer’s live alpha, with editable sources and Undo.
items.boundary: Invalid or cyclic references are refused. Layer-alpha clipping and vector clipping silhouettes are separate relationships.

items.name: Editable adjustments and effects
items.current: Retain supported adjustment layers and effect stacks, including blend ranges and photo recipes, for later editing and reversible review.
items.boundary: Each operation retains its own colour, precision and admission limits; unsupported interchange can bake appearance.

items.name: Retained layout frames
items.current: Arrange eligible photo, text and vector children with flow, spacing, padding, sizing and bounded wrapping. Reflow joins the original Undo.
items.boundary: Direct unrotated children only; nested frames and clipping relationships are unsupported. Release rules for independent positioning.

categories.name: Vector, text and design
categories.summary: Edit retained paths, typography and appearance in the shared canvas.

items.name: Paths, nodes and handles
items.current: Draw editable paths and move, add, split or join supported nodes and curve handles with direct canvas tools.
items.boundary: Geometry operations are bounded; unsupported appearances are refused before changing artwork.

items.name: Image Trace and reversible Simplify
items.current: Convert supported images into editable paths. Simplify compares against retained originals, preserves corners and supports original overlay/reset.
items.boundary: Not exact reconstruction of every image. Dense paths, topology and review work have limits.

items.name: Direct gradients and paint quality
items.current: Move gradient geometry/stops on canvas; keep Classic or opt into OKLab Perceptual and deterministic fill Dither.
items.boundary: Extended paints require document format 18 / scene 6. Export expands perceptual stops and rasterizes dithered objects with a report.

items.name: Group isolation
items.current: Enter nested groups, pick/edit within that scope, and use breadcrumbs or Escape to step out while retaining edits.
items.boundary: Surrounding dimming is an editing aid, not saved opacity. Structural work still follows lock and scope rules.

items.name: Editable vector clipping
items.current: Edit a retained mask silhouette or its full contents and preserve the relationship with Undo and native saving. Escape cancels an active gesture.
items.boundary: Clipping-drag polish is in progress for this candidate. Closed paths only; nested clips/live-text masks unsupported. Requires document format 16 / scene 5.

items.name: Transform again, copies and shapes
items.current: Repeat supported transforms, make editable copies, configure stars/polygons and swap solid fill/stroke with X.
items.boundary: Copies are independent, not live instances. Unsupported geometry/appearance and excessive work are refused.

items.name: Pen contact snapping
items.current: Enable bounded tangent/perpendicular contacts for supported straight Pen segments, alongside existing anchors and snapping guides.
items.boundary: Off initially. Ordinary anchors take precedence; Shift/Alt bypass contacts. Not a general geometric-constraint system.

items.name: Editable text and installed-font audition
items.current: Edit live text and preview fonts on actual text. Compare up to three installed-font samples with Unicode/fallback information and reversible Keep/Cancel.
items.boundary: Samples are bounded and can clip. Check the real text box, wrapping, installed families and script coverage.

categories.name: Create and content
categories.summary: Build editable branded posts, page sets and short motion content.

items.name: Multi-page Create projects
items.current: Create, duplicate, order and edit pages in one .omuse collection while keeping the active page on the normal canvas.
items.boundary: Canvas and collection histories have distinct ownership. Save/back up the entire package, including inactive pages.

items.name: Editable templates and brand settings
items.current: Start from native text/shape/image templates and reuse brand colours, fonts and spacing across designs.
items.boundary: Templates remain editable starting points; imported fonts/assets retain their own availability and licence requirements.

items.name: Reusable components
items.current: Save suitable content as a shared component, insert instances and use supported overrides/update actions across pages.
items.boundary: Component rules and cross-page edits have bounded validation and conflict handling; not every arbitrary layer relationship is reusable.

items.name: Local asset library
items.current: Import and reuse images/assets from the existing library controls while keeping content creation in the editor.
items.boundary: Availability and redistribution rights depend on the selected asset. This does not provide an unrestricted stock-asset licence.

items.name: Short motion content
items.current: Preview and export supported page/layer motion as MP4 or GIF when the required media tools are available.
items.boundary: Bounded content animation, not a full video editor; runtime/export constraints and final framing still apply.

items.name: Content packs and export review
items.current: Export ordered image pages and multi-page PDF with supported captions, alt text and manifests; inspect phone-size content before export.
items.boundary: Check current platform dimensions and final files. Generated captions/alt text require editorial review.

categories.name: AI and review
categories.summary: Choose an available connection and review proposed artwork before keeping it.

items.name: Assistant task review
items.current: Ask for supported content/design edits, inspect proposed changes and use the existing Keep/Undo workflow.
items.boundary: The task, selected target, locks and current document govern what can be applied; arbitrary assistant instructions are not guaranteed executable.

items.name: Image proposals and replacement
items.current: Supported connections can propose generated imagery or image edits for in-app preview, comparison and reversible acceptance.
items.boundary: Provider capabilities and setup differ. Review framing, protected areas and image quality; availability is not universal.

items.name: Per-task routing and connection checks
items.current: Choose an available provider/tool for a task and inspect connection/capability checks before running it.
items.boundary: A connection does not imply every image or assistant task is supported. External services have their own access and billing rules.

items.name: Optional guided local subject masks
items.current: Use positive marks or one box with an optional pinned local CPU model; review up to three options, brush coverage, Keep mask or Use as selection.
items.boundary: Experimental: six tokens, box uses two, no model-negative clicks. Explicit download/repair; model weights not bundled. Inspect/refine every result.

categories.name: Formats and colour
categories.summary: Keep editable masters and understand conversion boundaries.

items.name: Editable .omuse projects
items.current: Save canvases and Create collections as directory packages with retained sources/recipes. The writer selects supported feature versions.
items.boundary: New document formats 16–19 features need compatible readers; collection version 2 is separate. Rolling back the application does not downgrade a project.

items.name: Photo import and export
items.current: Open/export supported PNG, JPEG, WebP and TIFF workflows and retain supported high-depth inputs for appropriate photo operations.
items.boundary: Format, bit-depth, alpha, ICC and pixel limits differ by route. Use .omuse for editing history and retained sources.

items.name: Bounded Photoshop exchange
items.current: Import supported 8-bit RGB layered PSD/PSB or supported 16-bit merged composites; export converted8-bit layered PSD with reports.
items.boundary: Not full Photoshop round trip. Merged16-bit imports do not reconstruct layers; unsupported effects/text may remain pixels or require conversion.

items.name: SVG/PDF reports and inert metadata
items.current: Import/export supported vector artwork with compatibility reports and retain a small allowlist of inert SVG leaf-object labels/application attributes.
items.boundary: Conversions can reduce editability; dithered objects rasterize. Scripts/external resources and arbitrary root/group/definition metadata remain unsupported.

items.name: Colour handling and display proof
items.current: Use supported ICC conversion, retained RGB working spaces and display/proof controls without changing document pixels solely for display.
items.boundary: Not calibrated camera/lens/print certification; profile and format support is bounded. Inspect the intended output workflow.

items.name: Broader DNG/RAW decoder corpus
items.current: Planned: expand independently licensed RAW/DNG fixtures and decoder compatibility comparisons before adopting further decoder changes.
items.boundary: A file extension or upstream claim is not decoder support or colour accuracy. Sensor/layout/metadata edge cases need independent fixtures.

items.name: Broader colour-profile qualification
items.current: Planned: broaden profile/working-space fixtures and controlled colour-reference comparisons for supported import, editing and output paths.
items.boundary: Calibrated camera/lens profiles, HDR and print appearance remain separate unqualified goals, not current guarantees.

items.name: Broader interoperability corpus
items.current: Planned: expand independent PSD/SVG/PDF exchange fixtures and external-reader checks, prioritizing retained geometry, text, clipping and colour.
items.boundary: General Illustrator/Affinity/Photoshop parity and editable PDF/EPS import are not established by bounded current conversions.

categories.name: Native experience
categories.summary: Native controls, Omarchy themes and discoverable keyboard work.

items.name: Native shared editor
items.current: Photo, vector, live text and Create page editing share the Rust/GPUI canvas and layer model.
items.boundary: Feature-specific review panels and source requirements still apply; this does not establish equal behavior on every platform.

items.name: Omarchy theme integration
items.current: Use gpui-omarchy theme colours/fonts and consistent compact control styling throughout supported native controls.
items.boundary: Theme choices affect interface presentation, not artwork colour. Different display/font configurations still need usability checks.

items.name: Shortcut search and conflict review
items.current: Search/run commands through Ctrl+K, inspect keyboard references and review the current owner before atomically reassigning a shortcut draft.
items.boundary: Reserved/stale assignments remain guarded. Operating-system reservations and keyboard layouts can differ.

items.name: Contextual canvas actions
items.current: A contextual canvas dock offers relevant actions for selected photos, text, artwork and supported selections without leaving the shared canvas.
items.boundary: It yields during gestures and modal edits; the underlying command’s lock/selection prerequisites still apply.

items.name: View and colour controls
items.current: Use Fit/actual-pixel zoom, pan, grid/guides and shared colour-picker/swatches for supported artwork and text controls.
items.boundary: Display zoom is separate from native layer-pixel detail; changing a swatch does not imply every export preserves that appearance model.

categories.name: Reliability and roadmap
categories.summary: Bounded editing, clear save outcomes and explicit remaining release gates.

items.name: Confirmed and unconfirmed saves
items.current: Stage complete packages; distinguish publication from final storage/identity confirmation. Retain recovery/dirty/close protection and offer Retry or Save a Copy.
items.boundary: Unknown saved identity does not authorize blind overwrite. A dismissed notice is not durability confirmation; keep backups.

items.name: Linux save access policy
items.current: Preserve bounded visible ownership, modes, ACLs/xattrs and supported Create inheritance while keeping staged payloads private.
items.boundary: Different-principal behavior, hidden privileged metadata, timestamps, Windows ACLs and physical power-loss behavior remain unqualified.

items.name: Undo, recovery and reversible review
items.current: Keep accepted edits and supported collection changes reversible, preserve recovery data for unconfirmed saves and reject stale review commits.
items.boundary: History and recovery are bounded and do not replace a separate backup. Unsupported legacy readers can refuse newer masters.

items.name: Cancellation and memory admission
items.current: Supported photo/model jobs fence source/revision changes, own one active work chain and use conservative retained-buffer admission before heavy preparation.
items.boundary: Policy estimates are not hard RSS caps. Some bounded compositing kernels finish before cancellation returns; large histories can be refused.

items.name: Clean-machine and platform qualification
items.current: Planned release gate: qualify clean installations, dependencies, native interaction, upgrade/repair/rollback and final Linux/Windows packages.
items.boundary: 0.12.0 source CI and installer/package qualification are pending. Platform support is not inferred from a source build or earlier release.

items.name: Broader photo repair and mask quality
items.current: Planned: expand independently licensed photographic examples and review difficult removal, fabric/curb seams, hair, holes and protected detail.
items.boundary: Current repair/model results require judgement and manual correction. Mechanical preservation tests do not establish universal reconstruction or matting quality.

items.name: Large-document and long-session qualification
items.current: Planned: broaden sustained memory, cancellation, undo-history and export workloads at supported sizes while preserving sources and reversible behavior.
items.boundary: No fastest-editor, hard-memory-limit or universal responsiveness claim. Admission bounds are not a benchmark.
